text_block_list.text:
While out on an outing with Yaeno Muteki,
we ran into Maruzensky in town.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Yaeno-chan and Trainer♪
Are you two heading out as well?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Maruzen-san! What a coincidence
to meet in a place like this. Truly, an honor.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Actually, my father is a huge fan of yours, Maruzen-san.
I've heard about your achievements for as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Aww! Hearing you say that makes big sis super-duper happy~!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "Rumor has it Maruzen-san is also a master of 'traditional martial arts.' Flawless in both running and combat... truly admirable."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I myself am constantly striving every day
to achieve greatness just like Maruzen-san.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
I'm not really sure what "koryu" means,
but I'm honored to receive your praise!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: I know! I'm heading to a "nice spot" right now—do you two want to come along?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The secret to Maruzen-oneesan's hip and groovy style
might just be hidden here...!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: !! Yes, please, I would be honored!
I felt like there might have been a massive misunderstanding somewhere along the line... but regardless, I went along with Maruzensky to head to that "nice place."

text_block_list.name: Bubbly Women
text_block_list.text: "Ciao♪ Maruzen~♪"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ciao~, everyone♪
This here is Yaeno-chan, my junior, and the Academy's Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Allow me to introduce them! These are my friends
from the 'Bubbly Club'! We get together once a month
to study the cutting edge of fashion trends!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ho... Fellow practitioners from the same school, are you?
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Bubbly Women
text_block_list.text:
Nice to meetcha~♪ Mmm, what a preppie underclassman!
Hey, hey, care to have tea with your big sis?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Hold on, hold on! This girl is my precious
junior! Just because she's cute doesn't mean
you can invite her out for TGIF drinks!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Pri-pi... TGIF...
Hmph... Such arcane terminology.
Could it be the technique of some martial arts style...?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now then, you two. It's a rule that the Bubbly Club holds super hip rec activities every time.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
And・so, without further ado, I'm having you two join in as well!
Today's agenda is—

text_block_list.name: All Members of "The Bubbly Club"
text_block_list.text: Blow blow♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Mm! Th-This is... Iron Fan Techniques!?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, don't hold back, Yaeno-chan!
Get out there and strut your stuff!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
The art of concealed weapons is truly profound...!
Now, here I come!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Looking great, Yaeno-chan! Super duper!
I feel like I could keep fighting for 24 hours straight~♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Phoo! Phoo!
And so, the training(?) at the "Bubbly Club" continued—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you very much for today,
Maruzen-san. It was an exceptionally valuable learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The pleasure was all mine♪
Whenever you feel like getting in touch with the cutting edge, hit me up anytime! Buh-bye~♪

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: "...As expected of Maruzen-san. To think you're still diligently training alongside sparring partners outside the academy."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
However, though you called it cutting-edge...
That atmosphere still seems better described as
part of the good old days, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes. However, Maruzen-san described it as "new."
What this implies is—

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Truly... 'learning from the past'!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Building upon ancient techniques to create something new...
I see that as the very source of Maruzen-san's strength!"
choice_data_list: So that's the Bubble style, huh...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"Building upon ancient techniques to create something new...
I see that as the very source of Maruzen-san's strength!"
choice_data_list: So that's the Bubble style, huh...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...She was truly a master, just as I imagined from watching her race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
To have reached such heights while still a student is truly astounding...
It is on an entirely different level, one could say.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
If you would not find it presumptuous...
I would like to address you as "Master" from now on.
...I strictly insisted that she never do that again, and with that, our outing for the day came to an end.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Yes... the Bubble style.
No, let us call it the "Blade Martial Flow" [Bubble].

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Gentle on the outside, yet always keeping a blade in one's heart and never failing to polish it.
Truly a chō-very-good mindset.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
...Is something the matter?
You're making quite the flabbergasted expression.

"...Since her manner of speech was archaic to begin with,
it was hard to tell if it had grown older or newer.
This tone of voice continued for the next few days."
